lines.zh: 我抱着工具，在新屋里转。
lines.en: I carry my tools around my new house.

lines.zh: 我一步步量着房间的宽度。
lines.en: I pace out the width of the room.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来又站起来，来回走。
lines.en: I crouch and rise, walking back and forth.
I walk a circuit of the room's corners.
I walk to the wall and knock twice.
I shift across carrying a crate.

lines.zh: 我把地上的木屑踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick the wood shavings aside.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，找漏风的地方。
lines.en: I walk the walls hunting draughts.
I creep to the doorway and look out.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下来想想。
lines.en: Every two steps I stop and think.
I go around behind the workbench.
I carry a lamp into the next room.
I sit and line up my parts.
I push up my glasses and keep turning the screw.

lines.zh: 我在看一张很旧的图纸。
lines.en: I am studying a very old drawing.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西拆开又装上。
lines.en: I take the thing apart and put it back.
I sigh, softly.
I wait for the thing on the stove to cool.
I rub my chin, thinking.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪着，我懒得扶。
lines.en: My hat is crooked and I cannot be bothered.
I look up at the ceiling.
I am counting the bricks in this room.
Did you build this house? Not bad.
May I settle down here?
There is a draught in this wall.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，又低头干活。
lines.en: I glance up at you and go back to work.
You carry the smell of ironwork.
Do you have spare tools?
I am not an easy one to get along with.
Do not speak too loudly.
I rather like this house.
What I make holds together well.
I retreat behind the bench.
I hold my arm and frown.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的活打断了。
lines.en: That interrupted my work.
My glasses are askew; I straighten them.
The wrench slips out of my hand onto the floor.
I look at the wound and judge it.
I sit and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 你别再动手了，屋子会乱。
lines.en: Stop hitting; the room will be a mess.
I roll my sleeve down over it.
I stand slowly, a little unsteady.
May I have a look at that?
Any parts for me?
That iron fitting is just what I need.
Put it on the bench.
This tool of yours is very old.
Give me these and I will repair it.
Any coal? I am short of fuel.
Do not throw away that scrap.

lines.zh: 你把灯挂高些，我好看清。
lines.en: Hang the lamp higher so I can see.
This can be broken down for parts.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，工具散了一地。
lines.en: You bump me and tools scatter.

lines.zh: 我护住手里的东西，退了一步。
lines.en: I shield what I am holding and step back.
We both crouch to pick things up.

lines.zh: 我被撞得撞在工作台上。
lines.en: The knock sends me into the workbench.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的图纸，我赶紧拉开。
lines.en: You step on my drawing and I pull it clear.

lines.zh: 我的帽子掉了，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: My hat falls and I bend for it.

lines.zh: 相撞后，我先看零件有没有坏。
lines.en: After the bump, I check the parts first.

lines.zh: 你撞得挺重，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You hit hard and I grunt.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，好让你过去。
lines.en: I step aside so you can pass.

lines.zh: 我们分开，我拍了拍围裙。
lines.en: We part and I brush my apron.
I have only just settled in this house.
I am not suited to living with anyone.
Let me finish my work first.
That question made my hand slip.
I push up my glasses and say nothing.
I cannot make sense of such things.
I look down and keep turning the screw.
I spend most of my time alone.
Do not stand against my bench.
I roll the drawing up slowly.
I pick it up and look at the underside.
This part is still usable.
I put it in the toolbox.
I wipe it with a cloth before keeping it.

lines.zh: 这东西的价值我估不准。
lines.en: I cannot judge its worth.

lines.zh: 落地的零件我先搁台面上。
lines.en: I put the fallen part on the bench.
I lift it and test the weight.
This piece is cracked.
I pick it up and set it on the bench.
Whose is this?
Let me see that in your hand.
I set down what I am working on.
I look up at you, my visitor.
If you like, I will mend it for you.
I have your face written down.
I will take this job.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放到你的工具上。
lines.en: I turn my attention to your tool.
You are at the doorway; I saw you.

lines.zh: 那个方向有我需要的东西。
lines.en: There is something I need that way.
I push up slowly on the bench.
That thing of yours is interesting.
Let me look first, then talk.
I push my glasses up.
I need to look at this closely.
Hold out your hand so I can measure.
I have time today.
I watch you while working.
You have not put it down yet.
I polish my lenses and watch you.
I look at you over my lenses.

lines.zh: 你把袖子卷起来，我才好量。
lines.en: Roll up your sleeve so I can measure.

lines.zh: 我盯着那件东西，手没停。
lines.en: I stare at it without stopping my hands.
I can see where you stand.
I slowly move my tools aside.
You say nothing, and I still wait.
I want a few more looks at this.
I am wondering if it can be altered.
Put it on the table instead of gripping it.
I move the lamp closer.
Steady your hands; I need to measure.
I am still working out the measurements.
I will see this through.
I block with a wrench.
I push you back; keep off the bench.
That one came from a hammer haft.
I pry at your fingers.
You are shoved into the door frame.
I raise a hand to guard the drawing.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，我力气不大。
lines.en: Not heavy; I am not strong.
I jab the hammer handle into your knee.
I shoulder you to one side.

lines.zh: 你踩到零件，我才动手的。
lines.en: You stepped on my parts; that is why.

lines.zh: 我把你抵在工作台边上。
lines.en: I pin you against the workbench.

lines.zh: 这一下我倒退得比你多。
lines.en: That one set me back further than you.
I strike while watching the bench.

lines.zh: 我护着图纸，只推你一下
lines.en: I shield my blueprints and give you only a shove.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋子角落里修东西。
lines.en: I am crouched in the corner fixing something.

lines.zh: 你听见扳手落地的声音。
lines.en: You hear a wrench drop.
I stand up from behind the workbench.
I brush the dust off my hands.

lines.zh: 我抱着工具走进这间屋。
lines.en: I walk into this room carrying tools.
I hang the lamp before looking at you.
I sit down on the threshold.
I am settling in this room.
I brush the dust off my hands.
I push the door open a crack.

lines.zh: 我在屋里转了一圈才开口。
lines.en: I make a round of the room before speaking.

lines.zh: 我从床底下拖出个箱子。
lines.en: I drag a crate out from under the bed.
Fire catches my drawing and I slap at it.

lines.zh: 我从凳子上摔下，工具散开。
lines.en: I fall off the stool and tools scatter.
Water floods in and I cough, gripping the bench.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的零件全掀翻。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my parts.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的工作台，我缩手。
lines.en: An arrow buries itself in my bench and I pull back.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，图纸自己卷起来。
lines.en: A spell passes and my drawing curls on its own.
Too busy to eat, and my hands feel weak.
Lightning outside puts out my lamp.
The void pulls and I grip the bench leg.
